SQL Interface Changelog

Note
Release Notes Mention Only Releases with Feature Changes
MongoDB releases SQL Interface drivers and connectors in a continuous deployment manner. This release cadence allows us to continuously improve SQL Interface performance and stability. These release notes capture only those releases that contain direct user feature changes. If a particular SQL Interface release contains only performance and stability improvements, it is not included in these release notes.
Released August 26, 2026
Updates the MongoSQL Transition Readiness Tool to version 1.1.3.
Escapes database, collection, and field names supplied by the server before the tool writes them to the generated HTML reports. Previously, a name that contained HTML markup could run script in the browser of the user who opened a report. This fix addresses
CVE-2026-76798
and
CVE-2026-76794.
Escapes query text and user names read from Atlas BI Connector logs before the tool writes them to the generated HTML reports.
Neutralizes formula elements in the cell values of the generated CSV reports. Previously, a collection or field name that began with
=
,
+
,
-
, or
@
could run as a formula when the user opened the report in a spreadsheet application. This fix addresses
CVE-2026-76797.
Released July 30, 2026
Updates the
JDBC
driver to version 3.0.8 and the
ODBC
driver to version 2.0.10.
Upgrades the SQL translation engine to the latest version, which adds query optimizations and fixes an intermittent error that occurred when resolving the right-hand side schema of a lateral join.
Released July 23, 2026
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 2.0.9.
Adds support for Linux arm64 architectures.
Fixes an error that occurred when an application passed a null
catalogName
argument to
SQLTablesW
. The driver now treats a null pattern argument as equivalent to
%
, as the ODBC specification requires.
Fixes an issue where the driver could launch an operating system protocol handler for an OIDC authorization endpoint that did not use
https
. The driver now validates the endpoint scheme before opening the URL. This fix addresses
CVE-2026-19502.
Removes the OpenSSL requirement. The driver now uses
rustls
for secure connections.
Released July 9, 2026
Updates the MongoDB SQL Schema Builder CLI to version 1.2.1. The following fixes in this release address
CVE-2026-19502:
Fixes an issue where the CLI could launch an arbitrary operating system protocol handler from an unchecked path scheme.
Fixes an issue where the CLI logged the connection string and password in plain text to the terminal and to the log file. The CLI now redacts these values.
Released June 9, 2026
Updates the MongoDB SQL Schema Builder CLI to version 1.2.0.
Released June 4, 2026
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 2.0.8.
Fixes a connection failure that occurred when using the LDAP (deprecated) authentication mechanism with a password containing a reserved symbol (
:
,
/
,
?
,
#
,
[
,
]
, or
@
).
Upgrades third-party dependencies.
Released April 20, 2026
Updates the
JDBC
driver to version 3.0.6.
Upgrades third-party dependencies.
Released April 14, 2026
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 2.0.7.
Improves compatibility with applications such as SAS that look up the data source name during connection setup.
Fixes an error that could occur when your Business Intelligence tool retrieves the list of databases from your MongoDB data source and tries to retrieve more rows after exhausting the result set.
Upgrades third-party dependencies.
Released April 13, 2026
Updates the MongoDB SQL Schema Builder CLI to version 1.1.3.
Directs schema reads to a secondary or analytics node when one is available and falls back to the primary node otherwise.
Fixes an error that caused the CLI to crash if a view referenced a collection that didn't exist. The CLI now reports the error and continues.
Released March 17, 2026
Updates the MongoDB SQL Schema Builder CLI to version 1.1.2.
Fixes an error that prevented the CLI from generating schemas for time series collections.
Released March 16, 2026
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 2.0.6.
Improves connection performance on Windows by caching the DNS resolver after the initial fallback. The driver now performs DNS fallback only once and reuses the cached resolver for subsequent connections.
Adds automatic retry logic for transient errors. The driver now retries failed operations up to three times with exponential backoff, improving reliability when connections fail due to network instability or idle connection timeouts.
Released February 26, 2026
Updates the MongoDB SQL Schema Builder CLI to version 1.1.1.
Directs schema reads to an analytics node when one is available and falls back to another available node otherwise.
Improves the schema production for large datasets with unstable data fields.
Limits the number of concurrent tasks that the CLI runs, which reduces memory use and the number of in-flight queries.
Released February 19, 2026
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 2.0.5.
Fixes connectivity issues for SRV connection strings on Windows by ensuring the driver correctly falls back to the system DNS resolver if the primary Cloudflare DNS fails.
Released February 10, 2026
Updates the
JDBC
driver to 3.0.5 and the
ODBC
driver to version 2.0.4.
Fixes an issue where SQL queries containing an
OR
condition in a
WHERE
clause incorrectly filtered out rows. This occurred when one operand of the
OR
condition evaluated to
UNKNOWN
(due to a
NULL
or missing value in a nullable field) while the other evaluated to
TRUE
. This behavior deviated from standard three-valued SQL semantics and could result in incomplete result sets.
Important
On-premises (EA) users should upgrade to the latest driver versions (
JDBC
driver 3.0.5 or later and
ODBC
driver 2.0.4 or later).
Atlas SQL users receive this fix automatically. However, you should refresh impacted dashboards or re-execute queries to update existing results.
For the
JDBC
driver, connection validation failures now include more descriptive error messages that tell you the underlying cause. This improvement specifically assists Tableau Cloud users in diagnosing issues where driver or system logs are not directly accessible.
Fixes the
ODBC
driver compatibility issue with Power BI introduced by the previous version.
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 2.0.3.
Upgrades third-party dependencies.
Released January 8, 2026
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 2.0.2.
Adds DNS resolver fallback logic on Windows. The
ODBC
driver now reverts to the system default resolver if the primary Cloudflare resolver fails, ensuring reliable connectivity in restricted network environments.
Released November 24, 2025
Important
If you use Kerberos,
OIDC
, or x509 authentication methods, upgrade to
JDBC
3.0.4 or later and the Tableau custom connector to 1.4.5 or later.
Updates the Tableau custom connector (for the MongoDB JDBC driver) to version 1.4.5.
Adds sections to the connection dialog for specific authentication mechanisms:
Username and Password
,
X509
,
GSSAPI
, and
OIDC
.
Updates the
JDBC
driver to version 3.0.4.
Introduces support for
OIDC
machine flow authentication. This enables Tableau Server users to publish and refresh reports securely without relying on embedded usernames and passwords. The driver now natively supports machine flow authentication for
Kubernetes
,
Google Cloud
, and
Azure
environments, via the
authMechanismProperties
connection
URI
parameter.
Introduces Kerberos support for Tableau Desktop. This includes the addition of the following configuration properties:
jaasconfigpath
gssnativemode
gssapilogincontextname
gssapiserverauth
Released October 23, 2025
Updates the
JDBC
driver to version 3.0.3.
Adds new option
tlsCaFile
support in the URI and as a property
tlscafile
.
Released October 14, 2025
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 2.0.1.
Fixes a local privilege escalation vulnerability (
CVE-2025-11575
) in the Windows installer by correcting permissions for custom installation paths.
Released September 17, 2025
Introduces general availability of MongoDB SQL Interface. This modern toolset replaces the legacy
MongoDB Connector for BI
and provides a unified and consistent set of SQL drivers and connectors for both Atlas and on-premises deployments. This feature is now available for all MongoDB Enterprise Advanced customers with the introduction of the schema builder for on-premises schema management. To learn more, see
MongoDB SQL Interface Overview.
Introduces MongoDB SQL Schema Builder 1.1.0 for on-premises schema management.
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 2.0.0.
Introduces on-premises connectivity support.
Introduces support for Kerberos (GSSAPI) authentication, enabling secure connections in enterprise environments and providing a critical feature for users migrating from the legacy
MongoDB Connector for BI
.
Fixes an issue that prevented tables from being listed when connecting via certain tools, such as Microsoft SQL Server Linked Server. The driver now correctly handles
SQLTables
calls with null
TableType
parameters.
Updates the
JDBC
driver to version 3.0.1.
Introduces on-premises connectivity support.
Released August 12, 2025
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 1.4.6.
Fixes error in the
ODBC
driver version 1.4.5 that caused the driver to panic when a user with the minimum set of permissions retrieves the list of accessible tables.
Released July 29, 2025
Updates the Tableau custom connector (for the MongoDB
JDBC
driver) to version 1.4.4.
Removes log-related fields from the connection dialog to enhance security. You can still configure logging options
loglevel
and
logdir
in Tableau using the properties file (
mongodb_jdbc.properties
) to customize the connection. See the
Tableau documentation
for more details.
Released July 15, 2025
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 1.4.5.
Updates
ODBC
OIDC
default scope to send
openid
with
offline_access
and only intersect with IdP reported scopes if the set is not empty.
Makes
SQLEndTran
a no-op.
Updates the Rust driver to version 3.2.4.
Released June 18, 2025
Updates the
JDBC
driver to 2.3.0.
Introduces a new property
disableclientcache
to disable client caching in the JDBC driver. You must use this property with care and it is intended for server environments where the
JDBC
driver is used to connect to a variable number of customer databases to run queries at varying frequencies.
Warning
To avoid recurring re-authentication flows, do not use this property with the OIDC authentication mechanism.
Released June 12, 2025
Updates the
JDBC
driver to version 2.2.4.
Fixes an issue with the
JDBC
driver so that it now rejects invalid values for
setFetchSize
and provides a clear error message.
Adds
OIDC
default scope to support more IdPs configurations (for example, Azure
OIDC
).
Released April 30, 2025
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 1.4.4.
Released April 9, 2025
Updates the
JDBC
driver to version 2.2.3.
Fixes an issue with OIDC authentication not opening the browser for sign-on on macOS.
Enhances logging capabilities with additional information for the JDBC driver.
Released March 28, 2025
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 1.4.3.
Fixes a bug in
SQLDriverConnect
where the driver crashes if
StringLength2Ptr
is
null
.
Released March 5, 2025
Updates the Tableau custom connector (for the MongoDB JDBC driver) to version 1.4.2.
Renamed the connector from MongoDB Atlas to MongoDB SQL Interface.
Released January 6, 2025
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 1.4.2.
Updates internal
ODBC
processing to improve
BI
tools integration.
Released Dec 18, 2024
Updates the
JDBC
driver to version 2.2.1.
Implements
getCursorName()
to improve compatibility with database tools.
Improves error message for authentication failures.
Released December 6, 2024
Updates the Tableau custom connector (for the MongoDB JDBC driver) to version 1.4.0.
Moves the logging information UI for the Tableau Connector into an
Advanced
tab.
Released August 15, 2024
Releases version 2.2.0 of the JDBC driver.
Introduces driver support for jBoss Log Manager for logging.
Updates UUID string representation to the extended json uuid format
{$uuid : "val"}
instead of the generic base64 binary data format
{ "$binary":{"base64": "base64val", "subType": "xx"}
. For
subType 03
, you can use the
uuidRepresentation
connection option.
Released July 8, 2024
Introduces
OIDC
authentication for the
ODBC
driver.
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 1.4.1.
Adds conversion support for
wlongvarchar
and
wvarcchar
in the
ODBC
driver.
Addresses the low and medium static code analysis findings for the
ODBC
driver.
Released June 27, 2024
Updates the
JDBC
driver to version 2.1.4.
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 1.3.4.
Publishes checksum for validating the signed msi for
ODBC
.
Released June 24, 2024
Updates the Tableau custom connector (for the MongoDB JDBC driver) to version 1.3.0.
Adds the ability to choose between two authentication types:
Certificate / Token
Username and Password
If you choose
Certificate / Token
, the username and password are not required.
Released June 21, 2024
Updates the
JDBC
driver to version 2.1.3.
Introduces oidc authentication for the
JDBC
driver.
Adds caching of
MongoClient
instances.
Released May 22, 2024
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 1.3.3.
Adds a checkbox on the
ODBC
driver DSN configuration UI to indicate whether to limit the maximum string length to 4000 characters. To work with BI tools, like Microsoft SQL Server Linked Server, which can't handle variable length string data with no known maximum length, you must enable this option.
Released April 24, 2024
Updates the
JDBC
driver to version 2.1.2, which now ignores both "true" and "false"
setAutoCommit
values instead of returning an exception when "true".
Released April 22, 2024
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 1.3.0.
Adds support for result set data column-wise binding.
Adds support for SQLCancel.
Changes the non-standard data type (such as
document
and
oid
) default mapping from
SQL_UNKNOWN_TYPE
to
SQL_WVARCHAR
. This change affects only programmatic integrations relying on SQL type names; it doesn't affect Power BI.
Released March 4, 2024
Updates the Power BI connector to version 1.2.0.
Adds support for Direct Query. Direct Query capabilities require
ODBC
driver version 1.2.0 or later.
Released March 1, 2024
Updates the
ODBC
driver to version 1.2.0.
Adds support for
ODBC
clients requesting the driver to exhibit
ODBC
2.0 behavior.
Adds support for
SQLFreeStatement
.
Adds support for
SQLFetchScroll
.
The column order in result sets now adheres to the SQL-92 specification. Result set columns appear in the order they are listed in the
SELECT
query. For
SELECT *
, the result set column order is unchanged.
Updates the information returned by
SQLGetInfo
to report all supported date functions, time functions, and join capabilities.
Removes log level configuration at the DSN and connection level. The log level can now only be set as a driver property.
Changes the
BSON
-to-SQL mapping of
Decimal128
from
SQL_DECIMAL
to
SQL_UNKNOWN
due to incompatibilities between
Decimal128
and
SQL_DECIMAL
.
Released February 23, 2024
Updates the
JDBC
driver to version 2.1.1, which removes the SnakeYaml dependency and fixes an issue introduced in version 2.1.0 where data retrieved by column name was pointing to the incorrect index. The driver now retrieves the data under the correct index or reports an error if there are duplicate column names.
Released January 22, 2024
Updates the
JDBC
driver to version 2.1.0, which returns result set columns in the same order as the one provided in the select list instead of the alphabetical order.
Fixes the logger to only apply the logging configuration to the driver handlers and not other applications handlers.
Released October 20, 2023
Updates the Power BI connector to version 1.1.1, which fixes a bug where JSON values displayed as binary instead of JSON strings.
Released October 17, 2023
Updates the Power BI connector to version 1.1.0, which adds the ability to pass a native query when you connect. To learn more, see
Connect to Atlas SQL from Power BI.
Removes the log-level selector to comply with the Microsoft logging policy for Power BI.
Released August 17, 2023
Updates the Power BI connector to version 1.0.1, which adds a log-level selector to allow setting the logging level for each connection.
Released June 16, 2023
Updates the Power BI connector to version 1.0.0.
Released October 24, 2022
Updates the Tableau custom connector (for the MongoDB JDBC driver) to version 1.2.0.
Released September 19, 2022
Updates the Tableau custom connector (for the MongoDB JDBC driver) to version 1.1.0.
Released June 7, 2022
Preview availability.
